items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Not really, but we did some work together not long ago. When I say work, we played at UCLA, this event that Kenny Burrell spearheaded.

ctx.x: Black Widow by Lalo Schiffrin. Does that one ring a bell for you?

Not really, but we did some work together not long ago. When I say work, we played at UCLA, this event that Kenny Burrell spearheaded. We spoke in Spanish. That’s why it was unique to me. We’re back there in the green room, just speaking in Spanish. He didn’t know. “I didn’t know you speak Spanish.” “Yeah, I’m learning.” I say, “I’ve been dealing with it for a while.” I don’t know exactly where Lalo is from, but he’s – that’s his native tongue.
